verdict.rationale: AMD's product page lists concrete spec-sheet fields (cTDP 45-120W, NVMe RAID support, max displays, OS support, curve optimizer) and community corroborates quad-channel DDR5-8000 memory, suggesting a real spec sheet exists rather than pure marketing copy. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit clock speed figures, no AI TOPS number, and no disclosed test conditions/methodology for any performance claim, and community commentary notes benchmarks lack real-world buying context. Missing for 10: published clock speeds, an explicit AI TOPS figure, and documented test conditions/methodology backing performance claims.
